out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE HAND SOAP FOR HANDWASH SINK DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: SODA NOZZLES DISPENSERS IN BAR; INNER SURFACES OF THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RICOTTA AT 52F IN ATOSA 2 DOOR FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER TO FREEZER TO RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: COOKED GROUND SAUSAGE EXPIRED ON 09/21 AND TIRAMISU EXPIRED 9/17.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING. PLEASE ENSURE UNUSED OR UNSOLD REFRIGERATED FOODS ARE DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS..

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Wood or wood wicker is used in contact with food: BOARDS WITH FRAYED AND DETERIORATED EDGES USED TO ROLL PIZZA DOUGH IN FRONT PIZZA STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. DISCONTINUE USE OF BOARDS AND REPLACE WITH HARD WOOD, CLOSE-GRAINED WOOD FOR ROLLING DOUGH. EMAIL EHS ONE NEW BOARDS HAVE BEEN PROVIDED. PUPATELLA (Inspection Date: 09/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: PASTA AT 94F FOR 3.5 HOURS IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD PASTA DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE PROPER COOLING METHODS TO COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PESTO AT 71F AND RICOTTA AT 62F IN COUNTER IN PIZZA STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED FOODS TO REFRIGERATOR FOR RAPID COOLING. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO REMAIN ON COUNTERS UNLESS USING TPHC PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: PASTA AT 94F FOR 3.5 HOURS IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD PASTA DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE SMALLER PORTIONS IN SHALLOW PANS IN REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. DO NOT COVER FOODS UNTIL COOLED TO 41F OR BELOW. PUPATELLA (Inspection Date: 03/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REPLENISHED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BAR being used AS DUMPSINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE USED ONLY FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: BLADE OF CAN OPENER WITH ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO CLEAN CAN OPENER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Surfaces of the SODA MACHINE DISPENSER NOZZLE are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC CLEANED NOZZLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: PIZZA SAUCE AND WHITE SAUCE..
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY 4 HOURS TIME LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONSISTENT DOCUMENTING OF 4 HOURS TIME LABLES FOR FOODS USING TPHC PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH UTENSILS IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. CLEANING CHEMICALS IN SPRAY BOTTLES WITHOUT LABELS IN BACK KITCHEN STORED ON GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PUPATELLA (Inspection Date: 10/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF BACK KITCHEN DOOR AND BAR/OUTDOOR SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL DOOR SWEEP AT BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR; PROVIDE SCREEN OR AIR CURTAIN FOR BAR/OUTDOOR AREA TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PEST.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters: IN KITCHEN AND BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED WET WIPING CLOTHS FOR LAUNDERING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OBSERVED IN HOUSE & ONLINE MENU WITHOUT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT FOR TIRAMISU MADE FROM UNPASTEURIZED RAW SHELL EGGS. PIC PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED AN UPDATED MENU WITH THE COMPLETE CONSUMER ADVISORY AND TIRAMISU IDENTIFIED WITH ASTERISKS WHICH WAS APPROVED. APPROVED MENU HAS NOT BE PRINTED OR AVAILABLE IN THE RESTAURANT.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE EITHER UPDATED MENUS OR PROVIDE TABLE TENTS OR LABELS WITH CONSUMER ADVISORY INCLUDING DISCLOSURE FOR TIRAMISU BEFORE FOLLOW UP WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Pasteurized eggs substituted for raw eggs in uncooked, egg-based recipes
violations.observation: Raw shell eggs are used in the preparation of the following ready-to-eat foods without subsequent full cooking: TIRAMISU MADE WITH UNPASTEURIZED RAW SHELL EGGS NOT IDENTIFIED ON MENU WITH DISCLOSURE STATEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Pasteurized eggs or egg products shall be substituted for raw eggs in the preparation of foods such as Caesar salad, hollandaise, or Bearnaise sauce, mayonnaise, meringue, eggnog, ice cream, and egg fortified beverages and recipes that where egg ingredient is not fully cooked and when the consumer is not informed by a disclosure and reminder statement. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE SERVING TIRAMISU MADE WITH UNPASTEURIZED RAW EGGS UNTIL CONSUMER ADVISORY WITH DISCLOSURE FOR TIRAMISU IS PROVIDED.
